card.name: Words leading into named conditions
card.fires_on: Linking or modifying words just before a named disease or condition, such as 'rare' before hereditary problems, 'or' in 'Congenital or Acquired QT', and the start of cyst- disease names. Common in warning sections about patients with a given condition.

modes.label: Joining words before a condition
modes.description: Words like or and which that link to a condition name coming next.

card.writes: It suppresses 'diagnosis' words and promotes odd word pieces, so it adds no clear output effect beyond lowering diagnosis terms.
card.plain: It fires on small words leading into the name of a medical condition, especially in the rare hereditary galactose intolerance warning.
